title: Justified single-source defaults
description: The one way a behaviour with a single source repo may be classified `generic`. The corroboration rule is that one repo's opinion is not corroboration, so a single-source row defaults only when somebody has written down why it should -- and this file is that writing. Listing a row here is a deliberate act with a stated reason, and the justification is reproduced in the overlap report rather than left in this file for a reader to find.

id.description: The behaviour row's id, spelled exactly as `catalog/behaviors.yaml` spells it. The join is by id rather than by position so that reordering the corpus cannot silently move an exception onto a different row.

justification.description: Why this one repo's treatment is enough. Required and non-empty: an exception with no reason is indistinguishable from the rule not being applied.
